image_description: A vintage-style comic book cover featuring dynamic illustrated characters in action poses. The central figure is a green-skinned humanoid with white hair, wearing a futuristic suit, engaged in combat or movement against a red, monstrous background entity. Bold, stylized title typography 'VEGA' (partially visible) appears at the top. Speech bubbles and caption boxes with legible text are present on the right side. The image exhibits halftone printing textures and vibrant, saturated colors typical of mid-20th-century comic art.

artifact_observations.location: Character limbs and background fusion areas
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight blurring and 'smudging' where the character's white gloves/boots meet the background or other limbs, lacking the crisp ink lines typical of professional comic art. This suggests minor generative bleeding.
